items.requete: I'm not allowed to install anything on my Windows work PC, so I need a portable markdown note app that runs from a USB stick
items.justification: Le poste Windows est l'environnement cible ; l'interdit porte sur l'installation.

items.requete: An image background remover that uses CUDA to batch-process thousands of product photos
items.justification: Utilisation de CUDA voulue.

items.requete: Whether it's Docker or a plain binary doesn't matter, I need a URL shortener with analytics
items.justification: « doesn't matter » : indifférence.

items.requete: A Zapier integration template for building my own app's triggers and actions
items.justification: Template d'intégration Zapier = objet cherché.

items.requete: I lost track of the Kubernetes operator I starred for backing up volumes to S3
items.justification: Mémoire : opérateur Kubernetes.

items.requete: A tiling window manager for Linux, nothing that needs macOS or Windows
items.justification: Linux cible ; « nothing that needs macOS or Windows » : double exclusion.

items.requete: If it runs in Docker and exposes a FastAPI endpoint, I'll take any OCR engine for invoices
items.justification: Conditions « if » : Docker et FastAPI exigés.

items.requete: A boilerplate for React email templates that render well in Outlook
items.justification: Templates en React = objet cherché.

items.requete: A workflow automation tool written in Go, because n8n eats too much RAM on my VPS
items.justification: n8n est le produit à remplacer, cité en justification.

items.requete: A game streaming server for Linux that uses my Nvidia GPU for encoding
items.justification: Linux cible et encodage GPU voulu.

items.requete: I can't remember the name of the FastAPI admin panel I saved, it looked like Django admin
items.justification: Mémoire : panneau d'admin FastAPI.

items.requete: Tools to run Claude Code in a sandbox so it can't touch my home directory
items.justification: Outils autour de Claude Code = objet cherché.

items.requete: A Kubernetes-free way to do blue-green deployments on a couple of VPS
items.justification: « Kubernetes-free » : exclusion.

items.requete: I don't mind if it needs a GPU, I just want the best open-source text-to-speech
items.justification: « I don't mind » : indifférence.

items.requete: A clipboard manager for macOS that never loses its history after a reboot
items.justification: Critère de qualité sur macOS : plateforme cible.

items.requete: Zapier won't let us keep data in the EU, so I'm looking for an automation platform we can host ourselves
items.justification: Il remplace Zapier pour une raison de conformité.

items.requete: A React Native app template with offline sync, the backend can be FastAPI or anything else
items.justification: React Native exigé ; backend indifférent.

items.requete: Prebuilt Docker images for running Jupyter with CUDA
items.justification: Images Docker avec CUDA : les deux sont voulus.

items.requete: A backup tool for my Windows gaming PC that doesn't require Docker or WSL
items.justification: Windows cible ; « doesn't require Docker » : exclusion.

items.requete: I want to automate my invoices in n8n, are there workflows that read PDFs and fill a spreadsheet?
items.justification: Workflows n8n = objet cherché.

items.requete: Since we already pay for Zapier, I'm looking for Zapier templates that route support tickets to Slack
items.justification: « Since » causal : il cherche des templates Zapier.

items.requete: I need a Kubernetes YAML linter, and it has to run on Windows without WSL
items.justification: Kubernetes objet du linter ; Windows plateforme exigée.

items.requete: A pomodoro timer for Linux, no Electron, no React, just native
items.justification: Linux cible ; « no React » : exclusion.

items.requete: MCP servers I can plug into Claude Code to query Jira and Confluence
items.justification: Serveurs MCP pour Claude Code = objet cherché.

items.requete: A self-hosted CI runner that works without Docker, as long as it supports macOS builds
items.justification: « without Docker » : exclusion ; « as long as » : macOS exigé.

items.requete: A Dropbox-like file sync tool that works properly on Linux, I can't stand the official client
items.justification: Linux = plateforme cible.

items.requete: My laptop has no Nvidia card, so I need a face recognition library that's CPU-only
items.justification: Pas de carte Nvidia : GPU exclu.

items.requete: Any FastAPI project that streams LLM responses with server-sent events, I saved one last month
items.justification: Mémoire : projet FastAPI.
